events.title: Duke Ellington Sacred Concert
events.description: Hear one of the 20th century’s most visionary musical statements - where jazz meets the sacred, through community voices coming together in sound. Composed in the final decade of Duke Ellington’s life, his Sacred Concerts represent what he called “the most important thing I have done.” Designed for choir, soloists, and instrumental ensemble, these works fuse jazz, gospel, blues, and classical traditions into a vibrant and deeply human musical language.
